description: This Java source file defines the PackingServices class in the org.apache.ofbiz.shipment.packing package. It provides a set of static methods for managing the packing process in an order shipment system, including adding package lines, bulk packing, package sequence management, clearing packed lines, and calculating shipping charges. It interacts with a PackingSession object to perform these operations and utilizes various utility classes and service utilities from the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PackingServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate packaging operations within the OFBiz shipment module. Handles package line management, bulk packing, sequence handling, and shipping cost calculations.

methods.name: addPackLine
methods.description: Adds or increases a line item in the current packing session with details such as product, quantity, weight, and instructions.

methods.name: packBulk
methods.description: Handles bulk packing operations, allowing multiple items with specified packages, quantities, and weights to be processed in a single service call.

methods.name: incrementPackageSeq
methods.description: Increments the package sequence number within a packing session and returns the new sequence number.

methods.name: clearLastPackage
methods.description: Clears the most recently added package from the packing session and returns the new next package sequence.

methods.name: clearPackLine
methods.description: Removes a specific pack line identified by orderId, orderItemSeqId, productId, etc., from the packing session.

methods.name: clearPackAll
methods.description: Clears all pack lines within the current packing session.

methods.name: calcPackSessionAdditionalShippingCharge
methods.description: Calculates and sets additional shipping charges based on package weights and shipment details.

methods.name: completePack
methods.description: Completes the packing process, finalizing the session and returning the shipment ID or errors if any.

methods.name: setSessionPackageWeights
methods.description: Sets weights for each package in the session and returns total shippable weight.

methods.name: setSessionShipmentBoxTypes
methods.description: Assigns box types to packages within the session.
